questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

× and ÷

I. 7 + 8 ÷ 2 × 4 - 6

II. 16 × 4 + 13 ÷ 2 - 3
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the signs × and ÷:

I. 7 + 8 ÷ 2 × 4 - 6 ⇒ 7 + 8 × 2 ÷ 4 - 6

⇒ 7 + 8 × __**2 **____**÷**____** 4**__ - 6

⇒ 7 + __**8 **____**× 0.5**__ - 6

⇒ __**7 + **____**4**__ - 6

⇒ __**11**____** - 6**__

⇒ **5**

II. 16 × 4 + 13 ÷ 2 - 3 ⇒ 16 ÷ 4 + 13 × 2 - 3

⇒ __**16 ÷ 4**__ + 13 × 2 - 3

⇒ 4 + __**13 × 2**__ - 3

⇒ __**4 + 26**__ - 3

⇒ __**30 - 3**__

⇒ **27**

Thus, after interchanging the given two signs what the values of equation (I) and (II) will be 5 and 27 respectively.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six persons P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only two persons are sitting between P2 and P6. Only one person is sitting between P2 and P4. P5 is sitting to the immediate right of P3. P1 is sitting second to the right of P6. Who is sitting on the immediate left of P4?
questions.solution:
Given: Six persons P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) Only two persons are sitting between P2 and P6.

2) P1 is sitting second to the right of P6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a35fb72e08cfa906dccae7778c50e8959055f562e80bf60a370324195bd8602.png] 

3) P5 is sitting to the immediate right of P3.

4) Only one person is sitting between P2 and P4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34e320fab21ddf7f21b977430e9abff0af4c5927c0c90428fd241e42a4795848.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement P6 is sitting on the immediate left of P4.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All R are T.

II. Some X are R.

**Conclusions:**

I. No T are R.

II. Some R are X.

III. No X are T.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/affe9734a887a4d6a5c29db7e1d6a5360e03449ac629af7c1e2be559b1c52275.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No T are R → Does not follow (As all R are T. As whole R comes in T, therefore it is false.)

II. Some R are X → Follow (As some X are R. As some part of X is common with R, therefore it is true.)

III. No X are T → Does not follow (As all R are T and some X are R. As some part of X is common with R which whole comes in T, therefore it is not possible thus is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

uuvvwwuuv_wwuu_vww_ _vvww
questions.solution:
Given series: uuvvwwuuv_wwuu_vww_ _vvww

Option 1) vvww→ uuvvwwuuv__v__wwuu__v__vww__w__ __w__vvww → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) wvwv → uuvvwwuuv__w__wwuu__v__vww__w__ __v__vvww → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) uvwv → uuvvwwuuv__u__wwuu__v__vww__w__ __v__vvww → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) vvuu → uuvvwwuuv__**v**__wwuu__**v**__vww__**u**__ __**u**__vvww → (It follows the pattern of: uuvvww - uuvvww - uuvvww - uuvvww)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). A is second to the left of D. D is third to the left of E. C is third to the right of G. G is not the immediate neighbour of E. H is third to the right of B. B is second to the right of G. Who is sitting on the immediate left of G ?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) A is second to the left of D. 

2) D is third to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7f1287ae566eb5ca7fbb3f22b894e1a85c33f2541c190022b6cda4e800f0018.png] 

3) G is not the immediate neighbour of E.

4) C is third to the right of G.

5) B is second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3784ac1d2ace7cc3daf9febf1ef7f17000aa11bf378b0b1c92a346550f7c441e.png] 

6) H is third to the right of B. 

After positioning H only one position is left which will be occupied by the only girl left i.e F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79a8a63d3a6c0c8da89f0ab03f83891324eb0e3edc4ab35d172ca533b693c9e7.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement A is sitting on the immediate left of G.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
